verdict.rationale: Alloy is a fraud/KYC/AML decisioning platform, so recording notes, evidence and decision reasons in an investigation history is a fair question for it. The pack shows only that Investigations exist (workflows can generate investigations; some endpoints are deprecated in favor of Investigations). Nothing documents adding notes, attaching evidence, or capturing decision reasons in an investigation timeline or history.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can record evidence, notes and decision reasons in the investigation history
